name: Vaulting Knotcenter
description: A square stance with the weights hanging low lets the thrower choose any line for a tangling cast.

name: Facet Wrapup
description: The thrower loops the cord wide to arrive at the target's blind leg rather than the one facing the thrower.

name: Fastening Stonehead
description: Both hands lock on the cord at the joint of two wraps so the knot cannot slip under strain.

name: Remnant Ballsling
description: The thrower judges from the sound of the weights landing whether they have wrapped or only glanced off.

name: Fastening Bolaweight
description: Qi spreads the weights wide in flight so the cords cross about an opponent's thighs and shins together.

name: Might Tripcord
description: A qi-charged jerk sends the cast weights whipping back to rap the target across the back of the knees.

name: Ponderous Whirlcast
description: A strong qi cast drives the cords through one another in flight so they land already knotted about legs and hips.

name: Deed Cordthree
description: The thrower pegs a low cord across a path and charges it with qi so a running foe trips and tangles.

name: Bolaelixir
description: The palm feels the pull of each swung weight through the cord so the thrower knows where all of them are unseen.

name: Scything Heavyball
description: One unbroken pull carries the weights from behind the shoulder to the target without a hitch in the cord.

name: Murk Joinknot
description: The wrist rolls the cord in a small constant circle that deflects darts and cut ends before they reach the arm.

name: Silthobble
description: The thrower plants one foot and pivots on it to bring the weights around to a new target.

name: Blazeorb
description: A short chop of the fist-held ball checks an opponent's reaching hand before the cord is thrown.

name: Chime Bindfall
description: Qi extends the cast so the weights fly past ordinary range and still wrap the target's legs.

name: Ponderous Hobble
description: Pulses of qi along the cord draw the wrapped legs tighter with every haul of the thrower's arms.

name: Iron Cordfork
description: The weights circle the thrower in a steady orbit that qi keeps spinning against repeated blows.

name: Slagbola
description: The weights orbit in a widening circle and sweep several opponents at once into stumbling and falling.

name: Equipoise Spindle
description: A slow pass over open ground lays a web of staked cords that snags every foot crossing it.

name: Vaulting Bindfall
description: The thrower walks backward and pays out the line smoothly so it never kinks or snags on the ground.

name: Facetfetter
description: A flat cast lays the weights in a wide loop so the quarry runs into the line itself.

name: Thorn Heavyball
description: The thrower drives a short peg through the cord's end into soft ground and fixes the snared target in place.

name: Manacling Shackle
description: A flick of loose slack up the line tangles the weights about a lifted knife hand.

name: Dominating Spindle
description: Qi in the hauled line draws the wrapped legs steadily together until the quarry cannot stand.

name: Gustorb
description: A line stiffened with qi is snapped up across the body to turn a falling blade aside.

name: Chimeorb
description: A heave on the line at the right instant spins the quarry around so it falls on its back.

name: Thorn Knotcenter
description: Two pegged lines are crossed low and charged with qi so a pursuer tangles himself in the crossing.

name: Tiered Lot Shackle
description: In one flowing sequence the thrower casts, takes up slack, hauls the quarry's feet from under it and pins the cord underfoot.

name: Verity Tripcord
description: The thrower reads the ground and the target and chooses the light weights or the heavy ones before casting.

name: Hoarfrost Stonehead
description: Feet planted, the thrower swings the weights in a clean arc and releases at shoulder height.

name: Stonetorment
description: The weights skip across the ground to wrap the legs of a target that watches the air.

name: Ironorb
description: Turning slowly on the spot, the thrower keeps a cord stretched between the hands as a barrier before the body.

name: Rumble Hobble
description: The cord's tail hooks behind a stepping ankle and trips the opponent mid-step.

name: Silt Whirlcast
description: A short quick step regains balance after a hard throw and brings the weights back to hand.

name: Glint Cordthree
description: Qi gathers in a single iron-cored weight that is flung to punch through leather and quilted cloth.

name: Thornwrapup
description: A throw at the weapon arm wraps it to the body so the opponent cannot swing freely.

name: Joinknot Greave
description: The thrower snatches a missed weight out of the air by its cord and turns it into a parry.

name: Fetter Maelstrom
description: One full circle of the whirling weights tangles every opponent within the cords' reach about the legs.

name: Hour Ballsling
description: After binding one foe the thrower strikes him down, turns the weights on a second foe and hauls both together.

name: Siltfetter
description: Feet set paired and a weight hung from each hand so both cords answer to the same breath.

name: Facetstone
description: Both hands cast together in one motion so two weights fly to the same mark from different angles.

name: Torrent Bolaweight
description: The weights circle before the chest like the rim of a basin and send blows sliding off the edge.

name: Hamstringing Wrapup
description: Two cords thrown in an X cross about the shins so the target's legs bind each to the other.

name: Hobble Spurt
description: The thrower curves sideways around a lunge in one smooth bend, then turns back with both weights ready.

name: Ballsling Onslaught
description: Both weights swing short and strike together, one at the wrist and one at the ribs.

name: Ponderous Fetter
description: One hand's cord wraps high and the other low and a single pull locks hips and ankles together.

name: Fastening Tripcord
description: Both cords take one ankle each and are pulled in opposite directions until the stance breaks.

name: Cordthree Plating
description: Both weights meet a blow from either side and turn it down along the line of the paired cords.

name: Reverie Spindle
description: Two orbiting weights cross at the eyes and hide which hand will release first.

name: Rumble Cordfork
description: Two weights fall from above the head like a pair of stooping hawks onto the target's shoulders from different angles.

name: Daybreak Stonehead
description: The two cords sweep opposed arcs like twin channels about the thrower and tangle those caught between.

name: Waning Bolaweight
description: The thrower fixes one steady unblinking gaze on the target's feet until the moment to cast arrives.

name: Rupturing Bindfall
description: The thrower drops the weights in a steep plunge from overhead onto the target's legs.

name: Fetterjaunt
description: A curving turn in a wide arc keeps the thrower at range while the target tries to close.

name: Hobblecuirass
description: The cord's tail flicks across the opponent's eyes and spoils his aim.

name: Gyve Joinknot
description: The cords close on a limb like talons and qi draws them tight on the bone.

name: Facetorb
description: Two cords spread to either side like wings, with qi holding them rigid against a charge.

name: Hour Wrapup
description: The weights circle the foe at a distance like a hawk and wear him down with feints and short strikes.

name: Dominating Knotcenter
description: A qi-charged cast dropped from a rising arc seizes both legs of the target as a hawk strikes.

name: Cordthree Greave
description: The thrower stakes qi-charged cords in an open ring that tangles any foot stepping across it.

name: Wrecking Shackle
description: Two weights held as one pair are released a breath apart so the second follows the first down the same line.

name: Gustwrapup
description: The thrower flows with a retreating foe's motion and keeps a steady throwing range.

name: Annealed Heavyball
description: A hop with the weights lifted aside lets a low sweep run beneath the thrower's feet.

name: Gyve Bindfall
description: Two cords hold the target between them like banks, so he cannot lunge to either side.

name: Furrowing Fetter
description: The nearer weight raps the opponent's hip as the other swings clear of his blade.

name: Compressing Cordfork
description: The paired weights spiral about each other and the legs in a tight eddy that qi cinches shut.

name: Implacable Tripcord
description: Both cords flow along an incoming blade like two streams and pass it harmlessly on either side.

name: Ballsling Assault
description: A slow qi-backed drag on the paired cords keeps the target's footing sluggish and his strikes slow.

name: Hoarfrost Shackle
description: Both cords fan wide like a river mouth and close about legs, hips and sword arm in one qi-driven cast.

name: Intenthobble
description: The thrower casts one cord, strikes with the other and draws both home in a single flowing chain.

name: Glancing Hobble
description: The thrower faces into the wind with weights low and takes a firm bearing on the target.

name: Glint Bolaweight
description: The thrower lets the wind's push set the aim and releases when the cords lean true.

name: Ravaging Fetter
description: The weights circle freely in the open hand until a gust lifts them and the cast is loosed.

name: Torrent Knotcenter
description: Holding the bearing, the thrower flicks the cord to turn a thrust off its line.

name: Gyve Wrapup
description: A qi-backed cast leans into the gale so the cords curve around the target's legs.

name: Gyveorb
description: The thrower holds the cord fast by oath and haul, letting no struggle of the snared foe loosen it.

name: Hobbletorment
description: A tailwind and a qi-driven release carry the weights far past ordinary range to wrap a distant mark.

name: Deed Joinknot
description: A charged cord is pegged low along the plateau's edge so any runner crossing it pitches down.

name: Remnant Cordfork
description: The thrower sets a bearing on the target by the line of the wind across the cords.

name: Suppressing Whirlcast
description: The thrower grips the cord's end as if sworn to it and refuses to give slack to a straining foe.

name: Gust Stonehead
description: The thrower aims upwind of the target from the hip so the crosswind carries the weights onto his legs.

name: Surging Heavyball
description: The thrower pivots on the heel but keeps the same bearing on the target through the turn.

name: Lambasting Knotcenter
description: A long loping stride across level ground carries momentum straight into the throw.

name: Gust Spindle
description: The cord whips across the front in a line like the breaking of a gust and turns a thrown stone away.

name: Paralyzing Joinknot
description: A cast held true on its bearing wraps both legs and qi stiffens the cords against any pull.

name: Hour Heavyball
description: The thrower drags the snared foe along the ground by the sworn cord and wears down his strength.

name: Glamour Whirlcast
description: The weights swing as if a change of wind turned them and hide the true line of the cast.

name: Hobblecloak
description: A qi-charged cast sworn to its mark finds the target's legs and does not let go until the thrower releases it.

name: Bolacloak
description: The thrower lays charged cords across open ground in a spreading web that tangles feet from all directions.

name: Gust Cordfork
description: With nothing to hide behind, the thrower stands wide and loose and ready to cast in any direction.

name: Rumblebola
description: The wind pulls the cord out to its full length so the weights land at the farthest reach.

name: Gust Tripcord
description: The thrower leans with a gust and whirls the weights faster, loosing them at the peak of its push.

name: Verityorb
description: The thrower reads the far horizon for dust and movement to know where the quarry will break.

name: Granite Ballsling
description: The thrower catches a gust-blown cord against the chest so loose weights cannot swing back at the thrower.

name: Suppressing Bolaweight
description: With the wind at the back, a qi cast carries the cords round the target's legs and over.

name: Enduring Cordthree
description: The whirling weights meet a blade at the edge of a gust and carry it wide.

name: Stonegreave
description: A hard qi throw across flat ground snares a sprinting runner before the first bend.

name: Whirlcast Maelstrom
description: The weights whirl in an enormous circle under the open sky and drag down all who run into the cords.

name: Joinknot Plating
description: With no wall to funnel the foe, a hidden charged cord is laid where his stride must fall.
